about_the_game:
Arrow Dungeon is a fast-paced action roguelike where every shot counts.

You play as a weathered archer, making one final descent into a cursed dungeon teeming with monsters, traps, and mystery. With only a limited number of arrows, every encounter becomes a tactical challenge of movement, timing, and precision.

Explore shifting labyrinths cloaked in darkness, where light is your only ally and every shadow may conceal your doom.

Survive, adapt, and discover ancient relics to push deeper into the depths—until either glory or death awaits.

🔥 Key Features

- 🎯 Tactical Arrow-Based Combat

Use limited arrows and recover them mid-combat. Every shot must be aimed, recovered, or replaced.

- 🌑 Darkness as a Mechanic

Fight and explore in pitch-black dungeons. Use torches, magical light, and fire arrows to survive in the shadows.

- 🧠 Dynamic Monsters and Bosses

Enemies react to your movement and light. Face a variety of adaptive foes and multiple unique bosses.

- 🧭 Procedurally Generated Dungeons

Every run is different—explore branching paths, hidden chambers, traps, and random events.

- ⚙️ Skill Unlock and Gear-Based Progression

Earn new active skills and equip powerful gear that changes your playstyle.

- 🎲 Challenge Modes and Replayability

Conquer time trials, resource restrictions, and other special modes to test your mastery.

Are you ready to descend into the dark with only your bow and wits?

Arrow Dungeon awaits. Every shot is survival. Every run is your story.

content_descriptors.notes: Arrow Dungeon contains mild fantasy violence, such as combat using arrows and encounters with fantasy monsters including skeletons and ghosts. There is no blood, gore, or realistic depictions of injury. The game also features a dark dungeon setting that may be slightly unsettling for younger players, but it does not include any explicit content, sexual acts, or depictions of drug use, abuse, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
